title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta6

## Stable vendor trail rendering and OpenStreetMap proxy

This beta removes the remaining source overlap in the Map Card's current-cycle mowing view and adds an authenticated, cached OpenStreetMap tile path for the companion Map Card.

### Current-cycle trail arbitration

- Treat retained vendor geometry as authoritative **per zone** when a fresh vendor row is available.
- Suppress MQTT/session rasterization for those vendor-owned zones instead of appending the vendor swath on top of a second MQTT-derived swath.
- Keep MQTT/session geometry as the fallback for current-cycle zones that are not present in the fresh retained vendor response.
- Keep the existing trimmed MQTT live tail for motion that is still ahead of the latest retained vendor path.
- Publish current-cycle source diagnostics showing vendor-owned and MQTT-fallback zone IDs.

This makes each zone use one retained geometry source at a time and prevents small source differences from making the displayed mowing pattern appear to switch between vendor and MQTT renders.

### OpenStreetMap underlay transport

- Add an authenticated binary mode to the existing Map API for OpenStreetMap tiles.
- Fetch only tiles requested by the card; no prefetching or bulk downloading.
- Identify Navimower with a dedicated upstream User-Agent and project contact URL.
- Cache successful PNG tiles on the Home Assistant host for at least seven days and reuse stale cache data if the upstream service is temporarily unavailable.
- Validate tile coordinates and content before storing responses.

Map Card 0.3.7-beta2 uses this backend path instead of embedding `tile.openstreetmap.org` directly in SVG.
